facts.clause: This cooldown is reduced whenever Ziggs uses an ability.
Periodically, Ziggs' next basic attack deals bonus magic damage.
The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away.
Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after […] seconds, or when this ability is Recast.
Ziggs scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing magic damage and slowing.
